Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

WebShop: Towards Scalable Real-World Web Interaction with Grounded Language Agents (2207.01206v1) · paper method: WebShop instructions are written by human annotators from target-product attributes, options and price constraints; reward compares the selected product against these fields.
